title: Introducing OlmoEarth embeddings: Custom embedding exports from OlmoEarth Studio for downstream analysis
excerpt: A Blog post by Ai2 on Hugging Face

📄 Tech Report: https://allenai.org/papers/olmoearth | 📊 Documentation: https://docs.olmoearth.allenai.org/embeddings | 💻 Learn more about OlmoEarth: https://allenai.org/olmoearth

OlmoEarth Studio, our platform for building Earth observation models, now lets you compute and export embedding vectors—compact numerical representations of Earth-observation data produced by our open source OlmoEarth foundation models. The source code and model weights are publicly available alongside the research paper, so the community can inspect exactly how these embeddings are generated.

Embeddings are a fast, cost-effective entry point for leveraging OlmoEarth: they support a wide range of downstream tasks, from similarity search to segmentation to unsupervised exploration. Locations with similar surface characteristics end up with similar vectors; locations that differ land far apart. OlmoEarth embeddings have shown strong performance in our own benchmarking and in independent evaluations. The exported Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COGs) are lightweight and easy to share. Choose your area of interest, time range, encoder variant, resolution, and imagery sources via the Studio UI or API, and get back a COG you can use however you like. If your application requires higher performance, Studio also supports supervised fine-tuning (SFT).

Custom-computed embeddings are now available for users of OlmoEarth Studio. Reach out if you're interested in gaining access. Instructions for using the publicly available OlmoEarth models to compute your own embeddings are available here.

Computing embeddings in Studio

Global structure in OlmoEarth embeddings from seasonal Sentinel-2 imagery across 1.1M samples. Colors indicate 15 k-means clusters in a PCA-reduced embedding space.

Computing embeddings follows the same workflow as any other prediction in Studio. First configure a model and run it, and then download the results. Several parameters tailor the output:

  • Area of interest: Draw or upload any polygon; Studio handles imagery acquisition and tiling.
  • Time span: 1-12 monthly periods.
  • Encoder variant: Nano (128-dim, 1.4M params), Tiny (192-dim, 6.2M params), or Base (768-dim, 89M params).
  • Spatial resolution: 10 meter, 20 meter, 40 meter, or 80 meter per pixel.
  • Imagery sources: Sentinel-2 L2A, Sentinel-1 RTC, or both.

Different visualization options applied to the same embedding raster.

Studio delivers a COG with one band per embedding dimension. Vectors are stored as signed 8-bit integers (int8). Values range from -127 to +127, with -128 reserved for nodata. To recover floating-point vectors, see dequantize_embeddings in olmoearth_pretrain.

Because everything is computed on demand rather than pulled from a pre-computed global archive, your embeddings reflect exactly the conditions you care about. You can generate monthly embeddings to capture seasonal dynamics, not just annual snapshots.

What you can do with OlmoEarth embeddings

The examples below all use OlmoEarth-v1-Tiny (192-dim) embeddings at 40-meter resolution with Sentinel-2 L2A composites (annual for most examples; monthly for change detection). Tiny is a lightweight encoder but still highly performant; for your own applications, you can swap it for a larger variant at the cost of higher compute and storage.

Similarity search: Finding "more like this"

Pick a query pixel, extract its embedding, and compute cosine similarity against every other pixel. The result is a heatmap showing where the landscape looks most and least like your query pixel.

This query sits near the Merced urban center in California. Urban fabric and road corridors light up coherently while agricultural parcels stay dark. The model distinguishes built-up surfaces from cropland without any labels.

Switching the query to a small agricultural window, we define the query vector as the mean of the embedding vectors over that window, then pull Sentinel-2 imagery at the highest- and lowest-similarity locations to see what the model treats as similar and dissimilar.

The most similar patches (0.89 and above) are all agricultural parcels with irrigated fields. The least similar (around zero) are an airport with surrounding bare ground, a reservoir with dry terrain, and arid rangeland. No training data, no labels, just a dot product in embedding space.

Few-shot segmentation: Labeling the landscape

Similarity search tells you "where is it like this?" but sometimes you need discrete labels across a region. Because the representations are already rich, a simple linear classifier can produce a wall-to-wall land-cover map from very few labeled pixels.

To test this, we labeled just 60 pixels (20 per class) over Ca Mau, Vietnam, a coastal mangrove region. Using ESA WorldCover 2021 as the label source for three classes (mangrove, water, other), we randomly sampled 20 pixels per class, trained a logistic regression with per-feature standardization, and predicted every pixel in the region.

From 60 labeled pixels, the classifier produces a coherent map with weighted F1 = 0.84. Mangrove stands, tidal channels, and open water are delineated across the entire region. The classifier saturates quickly: increasing from 30 to 300 labels barely changes accuracy, because the embeddings are doing most of the heavy lifting.

The core of the analysis is a few lines of Python:

import rasterio
import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

# Load the 192-band embedding COG exported from Studio
with rasterio.open("embeddings.tif") as ds:
    emb = ds.read().astype(np.float32)  # (192, H, W)

C, H, W = emb.shape
X = emb.reshape(C, -1).T  # (H*W, 192)

# Train on labeled pixels, predict everywhere
clf = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000))
clf.fit(X[train_idx], labels[train_idx])
prediction = clf.predict(X).reshape(H, W)

This is a linear probe, a standard evaluation for foundation models. The fact that a logistic regression over 192 dimensions recovers land-cover boundaries from so few labels means the Tiny encoder has organized these ecological distinctions during pretraining. Larger variants (Base, 768-dim) encode even richer representations.

If you have ground-truth polygons, field survey points, or a coarse existing map, you can train a similar classifier and produce a wall-to-wall map for your own region of interest.

Change detection: Spotting what shifted

Because Studio can generate embeddings at any temporal resolution (monthly through annual), you can compare two time periods directly to identify where surface conditions have changed. Below, we computed monthly Sentinel-2 embeddings for the same region in September 2023 and September 2024 and measured per-pixel cosine distance. The Park Fire (July-September 2024) burn scar in Butte County, California lights up immediately.

No labels or training required—just two embedding COGs and a few lines of Python.

Unsupervised exploration: Seeing what the model sees

Sometimes you have no query location or reference labels. You just want to understand what structure exists in the embeddings. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a clean way to do this: reduce to three dimensions, map to R/G/B, and display as a false-color image. Similar embeddings get similar colors automatically.

Flevoland, in the Netherlands, is a reclaimed polder landscape with a regular grid of agricultural parcels. The PCA false-color image reproduces those boundaries with high fidelity. Different crop types, water bodies, and urban areas each get distinct hues. The embedding has internalized landscape structure without ever being told what a parcel or crop is.

This kind of unsupervised view is a quick way to see what structure the model has picked up across your area of interest.

From export to insight

Similarity search, few-shot segmentation, change detection, and PCA exploration are simple operations on standard raster data that run in seconds. The power comes from the embeddings: learned representations that compress earth observation data into vectors capturing rich information about each location from many sensors and millions of training examples.

Custom embedding exports are available now. Create a project, configure an embeddings model, and compute your embeddings. The exported GeoTIFF works with any geospatial tool: QGIS, GDAL, rasterio, or your own scripts. For end-to-end code reproducing the examples in this post, see the embeddings tutorial, which includes working code for similarity search, few-shot segmentation, change detection, and PCA visualization. To get hands-on without any local setup, try the Colab notebook.

Going further: fine-tuning

The examples in this post all use frozen embeddings with no task-specific training. Embeddings are a great entry point for leveraging OlmoEarth: they enable fast, cost-effective generation of results, work well in resource-constrained environments, and are easy to share. For applications that require higher performance, OlmoEarth Studio also supports SFT, training a task-specific model head on your own labels, which typically outperforms linear probes on frozen features.

Limitations

While we are always working to improve our pretraining approaches, it's important to check the quality of the embeddings for your use case using some of the techniques described above. Performance also depends on the quality of the input imagery—persistent cloud cover, atmospheric artifacts, or missing observations in the composite period can affect the resulting vectors.

Sentinel-2 L2A imagery from the European Space Agency, accessed via Microsoft Planetary Computer. ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 for mangrove reference. The global clustering visualization uses OlmoEarth-v1-Base (768-dim) with seasonal Sentinel-2 composites at patch size 8, instance-level embeddings over 1.1M pretraining samples.

blocks.html_en: Because everything is computed on demand rather than pulled from a pre-computed global archive, your embeddings reflect exactly the conditions you care about. You can generate monthly embeddings to capture seasonal dynamics, not just annual snapshots.

sentences.en: Because everything is computed on demand rather than pulled from a pre-computed global archive, your embeddings reflect exactly the conditions you care about.
sentences.zh: 由于所有内容都是按需计算的，而不是从预先计算的全局存档中提取，因此您的嵌入准确地反映了您关心的条件。

sentences.en: You can generate monthly embeddings to capture seasonal dynamics, not just annual snapshots.
sentences.zh: 您可以生成每月嵌入来捕获季节性动态，而不仅仅是年度快照。

blocks.html_en: What you can do with OlmoEarth embeddings

sentences.en: What you can do with OlmoEarth embeddings
sentences.zh: OlmoEarth 嵌入可以做什么

blocks.html_en: The examples below all use OlmoEarth-v1-Tiny (192-dim) embeddings at 40-meter resolution with Sentinel-2 L2A composites (annual for most examples; monthly for change detection). Tiny is a lightweight encoder but still highly performant; for your own applications, you can swap it for a larger variant at the cost of higher compute and storage.

sentences.en: The examples below all use OlmoEarth-v1-Tiny (192-dim) embeddings at 40-meter resolution with Sentinel-2 L2A composites (annual for most examples; monthly for change detection).
sentences.zh: 下面的示例均使用 OlmoEarth-v1-Tiny（192 维）嵌入，分辨率为 40 米，并带有 Sentinel-2 L2A 复合材料（大多数示例每年一次；变化检测每月一次）。

sentences.en: Tiny is a lightweight encoder but still highly performant; for your own applications, you can swap it for a larger variant at the cost of higher compute and storage.
sentences.zh: Tiny 是一个轻量级编码器，但仍然具有高性能；对于您自己的应用程序，您可以将其更换为更大的变体，但代价是更高的计算和存储。

blocks.html_en: Similarity search: Finding "more like this"

sentences.en: Similarity search: Finding "more like this"
sentences.zh: 相似性搜索：寻找“更多这样的”

blocks.html_en: Pick a query pixel, extract its embedding, and compute cosine similarity against every other pixel. The result is a heatmap showing where the landscape looks most and least like your query pixel.

sentences.en: Pick a query pixel, extract its embedding, and compute cosine similarity against every other pixel.
sentences.zh: 选择一个查询像素，提取其嵌入，并计算与每个其他像素的余弦相似度。

sentences.en: The result is a heatmap showing where the landscape looks most and least like your query pixel.
sentences.zh: 结果是一个热图，显示景观最接近和最不像您的查询像素的位置。

blocks.html_en: This query sits near the Merced urban center in California. Urban fabric and road corridors light up coherently while agricultural parcels stay dark. The model distinguishes built-up surfaces from cropland without any labels.

sentences.en: This query sits near the Merced urban center in California.
sentences.zh: 该查询位于加利福尼亚州默塞德市中心附近。

sentences.en: Urban fabric and road corridors light up coherently while agricultural parcels stay dark.
sentences.zh: 城市结构和道路走廊连贯地亮起来，而农业地块则保持黑暗。

sentences.en: The model distinguishes built-up surfaces from cropland without any labels.
sentences.zh: 该模型无需任何标签即可区分建筑表面和农田。

blocks.html_en: Switching the query to a small agricultural window, we define the query vector as the mean of the embedding vectors over that window, then pull Sentinel-2 imagery at the highest- and lowest-similarity locations to see what the model treats as similar and dissimilar.

sentences.en: Switching the query to a small agricultural window, we define the query vector as the mean of the embedding vectors over that window, then pull Sentinel-2 imagery at the highest- and lowest-similarity locations to see what the model treats as similar and dissimilar.
sentences.zh: 将查询切换到一个小的农业窗口，我们将查询向量定义为该窗口上嵌入向量的平均值，然后在最高和最低相似性位置拉出 Sentinel-2 图像，以查看模型将哪些内容视为相似和不相似。

blocks.html_en: The most similar patches (0.89 and above) are all agricultural parcels with irrigated fields. The least similar (around zero) are an airport with surrounding bare ground, a reservoir with dry terrain, and arid rangeland. No training data, no labels, just a dot product in embedding space.

sentences.en: The most similar patches (0.89 and above) are all agricultural parcels with irrigated fields.
sentences.zh: 最相似的地块（0.89 及以上）都是带有灌溉田的农业地块。

sentences.en: The least similar (around zero) are an airport with surrounding bare ground, a reservoir with dry terrain, and arid rangeland.
sentences.zh: 最不相似的（大约为零）是周围裸露地面的机场、地形干燥的水库和干旱的牧场。

sentences.en: No training data, no labels, just a dot product in embedding space.
sentences.zh: 没有训练数据，没有标签，只是嵌入空间中的点积。

blocks.html_en: Few-shot segmentation: Labeling the landscape

sentences.en: Few-shot segmentation: Labeling the landscape
sentences.zh: 少镜头分割：标记景观

blocks.html_en: Similarity search tells you "where is it like this?" but sometimes you need discrete labels across a region. Because the representations are already rich, a simple linear classifier can produce a wall-to-wall land-cover map from very few labeled pixels.

sentences.en: Similarity search tells you "where is it like this?"
sentences.zh: 相似度搜索告诉你“哪里是这样的？”

sentences.en: but sometimes you need discrete labels across a region.
sentences.zh: 但有时您需要跨区域的离散标签。

sentences.en: Because the representations are already rich, a simple linear classifier can produce a wall-to-wall land-cover map from very few labeled pixels.
sentences.zh: 由于表示形式已经很丰富，因此简单的线性分类器可以从很少的标记像素生成完整的土地覆盖图。

blocks.html_en: To test this, we labeled just 60 pixels (20 per class) over Ca Mau, Vietnam, a coastal mangrove region. Using ESA WorldCover 2021 as the label source for three classes (mangrove, water, other), we randomly sampled 20 pixels per class, trained a logistic regression with per-feature standardization, and predicted every pixel in the region.

sentences.en: To test this, we labeled just 60 pixels (20 per class) over Ca Mau, Vietnam, a coastal mangrove region.
sentences.zh: 为了测试这一点，我们在越南金瓯沿海红树林地区仅标记了 60 个像素（每类 20 个）。

sentences.zh: 使用 ESA WorldCover 2021 作为三个类别（红树林、水、其他）的标签源，我们随机采样每个类别 20 个像素，使用每个特征标准化训练逻辑回归，并预测该区域中的每个像素。

blocks.html_en: From 60 labeled pixels, the classifier produces a coherent map with weighted F1 = 0.84. Mangrove stands, tidal channels, and open water are delineated across the entire region. The classifier saturates quickly: increasing from 30 to 300 labels barely changes accuracy, because the embeddings are doing most of the heavy lifting.

blocks.html_en: This is a linear probe, a standard evaluation for foundation models. The fact that a logistic regression over 192 dimensions recovers land-cover boundaries from so few labels means the Tiny encoder has organized these ecological distinctions during pretraining. Larger variants (Base, 768-dim) encode even richer representations.

sentences.en: This is a linear probe, a standard evaluation for foundation models.
sentences.zh: 这是一个线性探针，是基础模型的标准评估。

sentences.zh: 事实上，超过 192 维的逻辑回归可以从如此少的标签中恢复土地覆盖边界，这意味着 Tiny 编码器在预训练期间已经组织了这些生态区别。

blocks.html_en: If you have ground-truth polygons, field survey points, or a coarse existing map, you can train a similar classifier and produce a wall-to-wall map for your own region of interest.

blocks.html_en: Change detection: Spotting what shifted

blocks.html_en: Because Studio can generate embeddings at any temporal resolution (monthly through annual), you can compare two time periods directly to identify where surface conditions have changed. Below, we computed monthly Sentinel-2 embeddings for the same region in September 2023 and September 2024 and measured per-pixel cosine distance. The Park Fire (July-September 2024) burn scar in Butte County, California lights up immediately.

blocks.html_en: Sometimes you have no query location or reference labels. You just want to understand what structure exists in the embeddings. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a clean way to do this: reduce to three dimensions, map to R/G/B, and display as a false-color image. Similar embeddings get similar colors automatically.

The power comes from the embeddings: learned representations that compress earth observation data into vectors capturing rich information about each location from many sensors and millions of training examples.

blocks.html_en: The examples in this post all use frozen embeddings with no task-specific training. Embeddings are a great entry point for leveraging OlmoEarth: they enable fast, cost-effective generation of results, work well in resource-constrained environments, and are easy to share. For applications that require higher performance, OlmoEarth Studio also supports SFT, training a task-specific model head on your own labels, which typically outperforms linear probes on frozen features.

content_html_zh:
返回文章

  • 在 Studio 中计算嵌入
  • 您可以使用 OlmoEarth 嵌入做什么 相似性搜索：查找“更像这样” 少量分割：标记景观 变化检测：发现发生变化的内容 无监督探索：查看模型看到的内容 从导出到洞察
  • 进一步：微调限制

📄 技术报告：https://allenai.org/papers/olmoearth | 📊 文档：https://docs.olmoearth.allenai.org/embeddings | 💻 了解有关 OlmoEarth 的更多信息：https://allenai.org/olmoearth

OlmoEarth Studio 是我们用于构建地球观测模型的平台，现在可以让您计算和导出嵌入向量，即由我们的开源 OlmoEarth 基础模型生成的地球观测数据的紧凑数值表示。 源代码和模型权重与研究论文一起公开，因此社区可以准确检查这些嵌入是如何生成的。

嵌入是利用 OlmoEarth 的快速、经济高效的切入点：它们支持广泛的下游任务，从相似性搜索到分割，再到无监督探索。 具有相似表面特征的位置最终会得到相似的向量；不同的地点相距很远。 OlmoEarth 嵌入在我们自己的基准测试和独立评估中表现出了强劲的性能。 导出的云优化 GeoTIFF (COG) 重量轻且易于共享。 通过 Studio UI 或 API 选择您感兴趣的区域、时间范围、编码器变体、分辨率和图像源，并获取您可以随意使用的 COG。 如果您的应用程序需要更高的性能，Studio 还支持监督微调 (SFT)。

OlmoEarth Studio 用户现在可以使用自定义计算的嵌入。 如果您有兴趣获得访问权限，请联系我们。 有关使用公开可用的 OlmoEarth 模型来计算您自己的嵌入的说明，请参阅此处。

在 Studio 中计算嵌入

OlmoEarth 嵌入中来自 110 万个样本的季节性 Sentinel-2 图像的全局结构。 颜色表示 PCA 缩减嵌入空间中的 15 k 均值簇。

计算嵌入遵循与 Studio 中任何其他预测相同的工作流程。 首先配置模型并运行它，然后下载结果。 几个参数定制输出：

  • 感兴趣区域：绘制或上传任意多边形； Studio 处理图像采集和平铺。
  • 时间跨度：1-12个月周期。
  • 编码器变体：Nano（128 维、1.4M 参数）、Tiny（192 维、6.2M 参数）或 Base（768 维、89M 参数）。
  • 空间分辨率：每像素 10 米、20 米、40 米或 80 米。
  • 图像来源：Sentinel-2 L2A、Sentinel-1 RTC 或两者。

不同的可视化选项应用于相同的嵌入栅格。

Studio 提供每个嵌入尺寸有一个带的 COG。 向量存储为带符号的 8 位整数 (int8)。 值范围从 -127 到 +127，其中 -128 保留用于无数据。 要恢复浮点向量，请参阅 olmoearth_pretrain 中的 dequantize_embeddings。

由于所有内容都是按需计算的，而不是从预先计算的全局存档中提取，因此您的嵌入准确地反映了您关心的条件。 您可以生成每月嵌入来捕获季节性动态，而不仅仅是年度快照。

OlmoEarth 嵌入可以做什么

下面的示例均使用 OlmoEarth-v1-Tiny（192 维）嵌入，分辨率为 40 米，并带有 Sentinel-2 L2A 复合材料（大多数示例每年一次；变化检测每月一次）。 Tiny 是一个轻量级编码器，但仍然具有高性能；对于您自己的应用程序，您可以将其更换为更大的变体，但代价是更高的计算和存储。

相似性搜索：寻找“更多这样的”

选择一个查询像素，提取其嵌入，并计算与每个其他像素的余弦相似度。 结果是一个热图，显示景观最接近和最不像您的查询像素的位置。

该查询位于加利福尼亚州默塞德市中心附近。 城市结构和道路走廊连贯地亮起来，而农业地块则保持黑暗。 该模型无需任何标签即可区分建筑表面和农田。

将查询切换到一个小的农业窗口，我们将查询向量定义为该窗口上嵌入向量的平均值，然后在最高和最低相似性位置拉出 Sentinel-2 图像，以查看模型将哪些内容视为相似和不相似。

最相似的地块（0.89 及以上）都是带有灌溉田的农业地块。 最不相似的（大约为零）是周围裸露地面的机场、地形干燥的水库和干旱的牧场。 没有训练数据，没有标签，只是嵌入空间中的点积。

少镜头分割：标记景观

相似度搜索告诉你“哪里是这样的？” 但有时您需要跨区域的离散标签。 由于表示形式已经很丰富，因此简单的线性分类器可以从很少的标记像素生成完整的土地覆盖图。

为了测试这一点，我们在越南金瓯沿海红树林地区仅标记了 60 个像素（每类 20 个）。 使用 ESA WorldCover 2021 作为三个类别（红树林、水、其他）的标签源，我们随机采样每个类别 20 个像素，使用每个特征标准化训练逻辑回归，并预测该区域中的每个像素。

分类器根据 60 个标记像素生成加权 F1 = 0.84 的连贯图。 红树林、潮汐通道和开阔水域遍布整个地区。 分类器很快就会饱和：从 30 个标签增加到 300 个标签几乎不会改变准确性，因为嵌入承担了大部分繁重的工作。

分析的核心是几行Python：

import rasterio
import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

# Load the 192-band embedding COG exported from Studio
with rasterio.open("embeddings.tif") as ds:
    emb = ds.read().astype(np.float32)  # (192, H, W)

C, H, W = emb.shape
X = emb.reshape(C, -1).T  # (H*W, 192)

# Train on labeled pixels, predict everywhere
clf = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000))
clf.fit(X[train_idx], labels[train_idx])
prediction = clf.predict(X).reshape(H, W)

这是一个线性探针，是基础模型的标准评估。 事实上，超过 192 维的逻辑回归可以从如此少的标签中恢复土地覆盖边界，这意味着 Tiny 编码器在预训练期间已经组织了这些生态区别。 更大的变体（Base，768-dim）编码更丰富的表示。

如果您有地面实况多边形、现场测量点或粗略的现有地图，您可以训练类似的分类器并为您自己的感兴趣区域生成完整的地图。

变化检测：发现变化的地方

由于 Studio 可以以任何时间分辨率（每月到每年）生成嵌入，因此您可以直接比较两个时间段以识别表面条件发生变化的位置。 下面，我们计算了 2023 年 9 月和 2024 年 9 月同一区域的每月 Sentinel-2 嵌入，并测量了每个像素的余弦距离。 加利福尼亚州巴特县的公园火灾（2024 年 7 月至 9 月）烧伤疤痕立即被点燃。

无需标签或培训，只需两个嵌入 COG 和几行 Python 代码。

无监督探索：观察模型所见

有时您没有查询位置或参考标签。 您只想了解嵌入中存在什么结构。 主成分分析 (PCA) 是一种简洁的方法：减少到三个维度，映射到 R/G/B，并显示为假彩色图像。 相似的嵌入会自动获得相似的颜色。

荷兰的弗莱福兰是一片开垦的圩田，有规则的农业地块网格。 PCA 假色图像以高保真度再现这些边界。 不同的作物类型、水体和城市区域都有不同的色调。 嵌入已经内化了景观结构，而无需告知地块或农作物是什么。

这种无监督视图是一种快速查看模型在您感兴趣的区域中选取的结构的方法。

从导出到洞察

相似性搜索、少样本分割、变化检测和 PCA 探索是对标准栅格数据的简单操作，可在几秒钟内运行。 其力量来自嵌入：学习的表示将地球观测数据压缩为向量，从许多传感器和数百万个训练示例中捕获有关每个位置的丰富信息。

自定义嵌入导出现已可用。 创建一个项目，配置嵌入模型并计算嵌入。 导出的 GeoTIFF 可与任何地理空间工具配合使用：QGIS、GDAL、rasterio 或您自己的脚本。 有关重现本文中示例的端到端代码，请参阅嵌入教程，其中包括用于相似性搜索、少样本分割、变化检测和 PCA 可视化的工作代码。 要在没有任何本地设置的情况下进行实践，请尝试 Colab 笔记本。

进一步：微调

本文中的示例均使用冻结嵌入，没有进行特定于任务的培训。 嵌入是利用 OlmoEarth 的一个很好的切入点：它们可以快速、经济高效地生成结果，在资源有限的环境中运行良好，并且易于共享。 对于需要更高性能的应用程序，OlmoEarth Studio 还支持 SFT，在您自己的标签上训练特定于任务的模型头，这通常优于冻结特征上的线性探针。

局限性

虽然我们一直在努力改进我们的预训练方法，但使用上述一些技术检查您的用例的嵌入质量非常重要。 性能还取决于输入图像的质量 - 持续的云层覆盖、大气伪影或合成期间缺失的观测可能会影响生成的矢量。

来自欧洲航天局的 Sentinel-2 L2A 图像，可通过 Microsoft 行星计算机访问。 ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 供红树林参考。 全局聚类可视化使用 OlmoEarth-v1-Base (768-dim) 和季节性 Sentinel-2 复合材料，补丁大小为 8，实例级嵌入超过 110 万个预训练样本。
